=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- docs/plans/analysis-findings-collection-hardening-plan.md:330-349 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The P6 cap on marker searches (APPLY_ANALYSIS_MAX_MARKER_SEARCHES, default 6) counts docs skipped for a dispatch marker. Retained marker-bearing docs from failed or closed projects at the front of the newest-first scan can therefore starve older unprocessed docs.
  WHY: The scan prints no candidates, so dispatch reports a false `all_docs_processed` and list-only mode logs `insufficient_docs` (scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:798-801), a stall that never self-heals. Reviewers rated this MAJOR; no severity disagreement.
- docs/plans/analysis-findings-collection-hardening-plan.md:331-336 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: APPLY_ANALYSIS_MAX_CANDIDATES (default 3) is said to need to stay at or above PROMOTE_CYCLE_MIN_DOCS, but no step, test or clamp enforces this.
  WHY: With PROMOTE_CYCLE_MIN_DOCS above 3, every tick logs `insufficient_docs` with no diagnostic pointing at the cap (scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh:136, 798-801). Severity disagreement: gemini rated it MAJOR; the others rated it NIT.
- scripts/apply_analysis_on_main.sh:342 (tests/test_apply_analysis_on_main.py:247-253) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The test expects `sort -rV` to order same-day filenames as -10, -5, then the unsuffixed file, but the reviewer claims `-` sorts before `.` so the unsuffixed file comes first.
  WHY: The list-only assertion would fail and dispatch would pick the unsuffixed doc first. Three other reviewers (sonnet, minimax, glm) checked and rejected this claim, so the disagreement is noted.
- docs/plans/analysis-findings-collection-hardening-plan.md:30, 382-386 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: D7 says "Six phases, each independently mergeable", but P2 must merge after P1 and P3.
  WHY: A merge-train reader could land P2 first. This is a documentation contradiction only.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
